head: bc67143a
nature: screen only -- NOT a paper number (single sequence, single seed, offline, non-causal ceiling)

inputs.poses: plot/trj_full_final.json trj_est (C2W); rendering uses its inverse
inputs.frame_selection_rule: content-only: mask coverage >= median of nonzero-coverage frames, then 16 frames evenly spaced in time (locked before any render metric)

arms.P2: per-frame transient insertion from that frame's own mask+depth + 300-step local fit (constructive ceiling, non-causal)
arms.C-: P2 result translated 0.30 m along the camera-x axis AFTER the fit (negative control / instrument check)
arms.P4: insert+fit at t0=309 only, then frozen (naive bake-in)

protocol.insertion_convention: repo's own GaussianModel._gaussians_from_points (KNN scale, Dataset.point_size=0.01, RGB2SH, inverse-sigmoid(0.5) opacity); mask pixels stride=3
protocol.fit: 300 iters, Adam groups xyz 5e-4 / log_scale 5e-3 / rot 1e-3 / opa 5e-2 / dc 5e-3, loss = in-mask RGB L1 + 0.1 * in-mask depth L1(m), seed 0

metrics.dyn_psnr: PSNR over dynamic-mask AND valid-GT-depth (implementation of the DynaGSLAM 'DynaPSNR' protocol, arXiv 2503.11979)
metrics.dyn_dl1_cm: penalized depth L1 inside the mask (holes charged d_max=50cm) -- same function as project P-A

protocol.pairing: same frozen map, same poses, same frames => paired comparison, no seed noise
protocol.insertion_depth_range_note: dyn_probe.py defaults; not in prereg 4/5 originally -- back-registered

reproducibility_L2.protocol: same locked config run repeatedly (rep1/rep2 + rounds 2-3); artifacts: l2_repeatability.json + dyn_probe_results_rep2.json
reproducibility_L2.note: quote the L2 band as <=0.012 dB (three runs), not 0.0055 (two runs) -- gate-1 minor
reproducibility_L2.cause: GPU rasterizer backward atomics during the 300-step local fit

material_check.ghost_inventory: map points projecting inside the mask: 12-13% (mostly background BEHIND the person); points in front of the GT surface (true ghost candidates): 2-1016 per frame (mean 83 gate / 157 baseline, <0.2% of the map)
material_check.implication: no material to deform in the frozen map => the minimal form must INSERT from observation, not deform existing gaussians

limitations: P2 is a constructive optimistic ceiling AND non-causal (uses the evaluated frame's own observation)
ATE NOT measured -- dynamic primitives' effect on tracking is unknown (DISCIPLINE #7 makes absolute ATE the first acceptance criterion)
online-vs-offline mask difference not quantified (frozen gtmc vs online MaskRCNN)
single sequence (person_tracking2), single seed, two same-batch maps => NOT an independent replication
in-mask depth L1 uses the 3DGS expected depth => sensitive to opacity
P4 used 11906 primitives = 3.37x P2's mean => arms NOT cost-matched; P4's static damage direction is credible but its magnitude needs a cost-matched rerun
fit 'effect' evidence is first/last loss only (P2 per-frame mean 0.113->0.027, opa 0.50->0.758; P4 single fit 0.140->0.029, opa 0.711); no loss curve
ghost inventory sampled every 25 frames (23 frames), barely overlapping the 16 eval frames => limited representativeness
prereg text defect: criterion 3 was written two-sided |d static| <= 0.25 dB; measured +0.12 dB (positive); intent is non-degradation
causal arms: still no ATE measurement (offline); ATE must be reported once the mechanism runs online
P2c's appearance-side retention is only 0.119-0.130 in PSNR terms (geometric retention 0.586 on the bad subset) -- both must be reported together
the causal arm degrades the static region by 0.78 dB (stale primitives occlude vacated background) => retirement/visibility is mandatory, not optional
the in-mask metric is heterogeneous because the GTMC mask area jumps 4k->116k px frame to frame; every in-mask number must carry its protocol (full mask vs M_bad)
causal round II used a 12-frame paired set (4 frames excluded) => numbers are NOT directly comparable to round I's 15-frame set; round-I references on the same 12 frames are quoted in the verdict
the three 'cheapest' mechanisms tested are all offline insert-then-transform; the NO-GO does NOT rule out online joint optimisation

round_5_causal3.calibre: all readings above come from dyn_probe_verdict.json:causal3_judgments (paired, n=15; frames [93,122,141,178,197,243,282,309,329,347,398,421,439,512,561]). diag_causal_fairness.json covers rounds 1/2/balloon only (see its 'sources') and is NOT a source for this round -- where cited it is a cross-round re-analysis and is labelled as such. AGGREGATION WARNING: E2/E3 (whole-set) and E7 (per-bucket) are NOT interchangeable; on the full set retention_of(means) and _retention_perframe agree numerically (E3 = 0.5021 both ways, because the analyzer's means ARE per-frame means), so the only difference is subsetting. Re-averaging the two bucket values by frame count (0.4459) is WRONG and matches neither. Bucket threshold = median n_dyn over the 15 frames = 3642 (matches the value independently recorded in diag_causal_fairness.json). Buckets are n=7/8, single seed, no variance/CI: the 'eats the whole gain' reading is an observational comparison, not a significance test. Worst-case: a reader must not re-average buckets
